{{Quote|I found this at the crash site."<br />"Hm. The lightsaber of Sifo-Dyas it is. Never found when he died it was.|Plo Koon and Yoda|<ref name="The Lost One" />}}
This blue-bladed '''lightsaber''' was a weapon that had once belonged to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Sifo-Dyas/Legends|Sifo-Dyas]], who also owned [[Grievous' first lightsaber/Legends|another]] blue-bladed lightsaber during his lifetime. Sifo-Dyas carried the lightsaber at the time of his death, and it was abandoned on the [[Oba Diah moon/Legends|desert moon of Oba Diah]] where it was discovered by Master [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]].

==History==
===Sifo-Dyas's last mission===
Sifo-Dyas carried this lightsaber when he was called upon by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Valorum]] to secretly negotiate with the [[Pyke/Legends|Pyke]] [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Syndicate]]. [[775519/Legends|His shuttle]] was shot down over the [[Oba Diah moon/Legends|desert moon of Oba Diah]] as a result of the machinations of [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] and [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. The Pykes delivered the Jedi Master's body to Dooku, but left the lightsaber in the wrecked shuttle.<ref name="The Lost One" />

===The Sifo-Dyas case===
Near the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Sifo-Dyas's crashed shuttle somehow sent a [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]] that reached the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Master Plo Koon and [[Clone trooper/Legends|troopers]] of the [[104th Battalion/Legends|104th Battalion]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Army]] traveled to the Oba Diah moon to investigate, and discovered Sifo-Dyas's lightsaber in the wreckage. As the body was missing and Jedi records mentioned that Sifo-Dyas's shuttle had been lost on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], not Oba-Diah, the Jedi Council began investigating the case.<ref name="The Lost One" />
